headline: Cat on track: Metro rail operations suspended for over 20 minutes
summary: A stray cat wandering onto high-voltage tracks at Shahbagh caused a temporary shutdown of the entire network on Saturday.
details: A stray cat wandered onto the high-voltage tracks of the Metro Rail line at Shahbagh, forcing authorities to suspend all train services for just over 20 minutes on Saturday.

Operations were halted from 11:50 am to 12:12 pm. This marks the first time the entire network has been affected by an animal, as previous disruptions have typically been caused by technical or signalling faults.
A Dhaka Mass Transit Company Limited (DMTCL) official stated that operations were temporarily suspended for passenger safety and that the cat was rescued unharmed.
The unexpected shutdown caused significant inconvenience for commuters, leading to long queues at stations and prompting many passengers to seek alternative transport.

headline_marked: Shivir leader [[arrested for rape and forced abortion]] after faking disappearance
headline: Shivir leader arrested for rape and forced abortion after faking disappearance
summary: Police say Jisan Mia, a central leader of Islami Chhatra Shivir, went into hiding to avoid marriage before being recovered in Laksam.
details: Jisan Mia, a central assistant international affairs secretary of Islami Chhatra Shivir, has been arrested following allegations of rape and forced abortion.
He was recovered in an unconscious state from the Laksam Railway Junction area in Comilla, a day after his family reported him missing from Daudkandi.
According to Comilla District Police, Jisan was not kidnapped as previously claimed by his family and political associates; instead, he had gone into hiding himself.
Police investigations revealed that Jisan had a relationship with a 25-year-old widow. After she became pregnant, he allegedly pressured her to undergo an abortion using medication.
The police claim that Jisan agreed to marry the woman on June 12 but staged his disappearance on the night of June 11 to avoid the marriage.
Following his recovery, the victim filed a case against Jisan at the Daudkandi Model Police Station under the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act.

While Jamaat-e-Islami and Chhatra Shivir initially expressed concern over his 'disappearance,' the organization's central president stated they would take disciplinary action if the allegations are proven.
caption:
He staged his own disappearance to avoid marriage, but police found a darker secret. 

Islami Chhatra Shivir leader Jisan Mia is now facing rape and forced abortion charges.

Jisan Mia, a central assistant international affairs secretary of Islami Chhatra Shivir, has been arrested following allegations of rape and forced abortion.

He was recovered in an unconscious state from the Laksam Railway Junction area in Comilla, a day after his family reported him missing from Daudkandi.

According to Comilla District Police, Jisan was not kidnapped as previously claimed by his family and political associates; instead, he had gone into hiding himself.

Police investigations revealed that Jisan had a relationship with a 25-year-old widow. After she became pregnant, he allegedly pressured her to undergo an abortion using medication.

The police claim that Jisan agreed to marry the woman on June 12 but staged his disappearance on the night of June 11 to avoid the marriage.

Following his recovery, the victim filed a case against Jisan at the Daudkandi Model Police Station under the Women and Children Repression Prevention Act.

While Jamaat-e-Islami and Chhatra Shivir initially expressed concern over his 'disappearance,' the organization's central president stated they would take disciplinary action if the allegations are proven.
